0022600195.text: The Trail Blazers (6-1) enter this 9th game of their season first in the Northwest and first in the West, riding a three-game winning streak and a 5-0 road record, though they are 1-1 at home. The San Antonio Spurs (6-2) are fifth in the West and second in the Southwest, 0.5 games back, on a six-game winning streak with a 4-2 home record and a 2-0 road record. Portland is missing Ja Morant (hamstring), Shaedon Sharpe (knee surgery) and Vit Krejci (ankle), while San Antonio is without Jayden Quaintance (knee surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain); the teams have not played yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Trail Blazers lost 1-2 in the regular season and 1-4 in the playoffs, most recently a 114-95 loss in San Antonio on April 28, 2026.
